 Live MP Police Constable Admit Card 2026 Live: Direct Link to Download Hall Ticket Soon at esb.mp.gov.in
 By Sunil Sharma Nov 17, 2026, 13:55 IST 
 MP Police Constable Admit Card 2026 : The MPESB will shortly release the MP Police Constable Admit Card 2026 for the exams scheduled to be held on November 19 2026. Check out this blog for real-time updates on the mp constable admit card 2026 . 
 MP Police Constable Admit Card 2026 HIGHLIGHTS 
 MP Police Constable Admit Card 2026 is expected to be released today on MPESB Official Website.
 The MP Police Constable written exam will be held on November 19, 2026 for 7500 vacancies.
 Candidates can download the Admit Card using their login details from the official website once released.
 Register for Result Updates The Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) will shortly release the MP Police Constable Admit Card on its official website i.e., esb.mp.gov.in. The MPESB will conduct the offline written exam on November 19, 2026, to fill 7500 vacancies of Constable in Special Armed Force (SAF) GD and Non-SAF GD in MP Police. MPESB releases the admit card around 2-3 days before the exam. Therefore, the board will release the MP Police Constable Admit Card on November 17. Candidates who have registered for the MP Police Constable recruitment 2026 can download their admit card from the official website once it is released officially. 
 MP Police Constable Admit Card 2026 Release Date 
 The MP Police Constable Admit Card with details of the examination centre will be available to download 2-3 days before the exam. So, candidates are advised to keep checking the official website or this live blog for real-time and authentic updates on the MP Police admit card 2026.  
 How to Download the MP Police Constable Admit Card 2026 
 Candidates can follow these steps to download their MP Police Constable admit card for the November 19 exams: 
 Step 1: Go to the official website of MPESB esb.mp.gov.in. 
 Step 2: Click on the “MP Police Constable 2026 Admit Card” link in the ‘Top Notice’ section. 
 Step 3: Fill in all the required details and click on submit. 
 Step 4: View and download the slip for future reference.

 LIVE UPDATES Check Latest Updates Nov 17, 2026, 13:55 IST MP Police Constable Admit Card 2026 Live: Number of Vacancies
 The total of 7500 vacancies of Police Constable being offered by the Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) through this recruitment drive. These vacancies are divided across two major cadres, which are as follows:-
 Special Armed Force (SAF):- 700 Posts (Male candidates only)
 Non-Special Armed Force (Non-SAF):- 6800 posts (which are open for both Male and Female candidates)
 Nov 17, 2026, 13:42 IST MP Police Constable Admit Card 2026 Live: Keep Login Details Ready
 Candidates should keep their application number and password or date of birth ready before the admit card release. This will help them download the admit card quickly without any delay. Candidates who forget their login details should recover them before the release date.
Candidate should keep the following details ready.
 Application Number
 Date of Birth
 Nov 17, 2026, 13:28 IST MP Police Constable Admit Card​ 2026 Live: Exam Pattern
 The MP Police Constable question paper will have three sections i.e., General Knowledge & Reasoning, Intellectual Ability & Mental Ability, Science & Simple Arithmetic. There will be 100 questions for a total of 100 marks , and no negative marking for incorrect answers. The total duration of the exam will be 2 hours .
